conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Telecom Haiku account services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Patricia here. What can I help with?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi, I need to update my address on file. I'm moving next week and I want to make sure everything goes to the right place.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Sure thing. I can update that for you right now. What's your new address?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: It's 567 Maple Drive, Apartment 12, in Riverside.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: All set. Your address is updated and mail should start going to the new location.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Sales department. Please hold.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Daniel with sales. How can I help you?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hey Daniel. So I'm curious about your TV packages. I currently don't have any streaming service but I've been thinking about getting cable again.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Great timing actually. We've got some really good TV packages with tons of channels and streaming options built in.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: That's cool. How much would that be? And like, what kind of commitment are we talking? I don't want to be locked in for years.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Good questions. We have month-to-month options too. Pricing starts at 89 dollars for our basic package. Can I answer any other questions?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Technical support. Press 1 to continue.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Rachel from technical support. How can I help?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Rachel. I just got a new laptop and I'm trying to connect it to my WiFi but it's not showing up as an available network.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Sometimes the router needs to broadcast the network name. Let me walk you through checking that.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Log into your router's settings. You should see an option that says 'broadcast SSID'. Make sure it's enabled.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Oh yeah, I found it and it's already on. But now I see my network!

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Billing department. Please hold.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Kevin from billing. What can I do for you?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Kevin. I wanted to check what my current balance is and when my next payment is due.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: No problem. Let me pull that up. Your balance is 135 dollars and 22 cents. Payment is due on the 20th.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Okay, that matches what I see online. I'll get that paid before then.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Perfect. You're all set. If you need anything else, just let us know. Thanks for being a great customer.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Technical support.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Amanda speaking. What's the issue?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: My internet is completely down. I've been without service for like three hours now and I need this for work. This is really not okay.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I'm really sorry. Let me check if there's an outage in your area.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Yes, I'm seeing a major outage reported in your neighborhood. Our team is working on it. We expect service to be restored within the hour.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: An hour? That's still a long time. Is there anything you can do to expedite it? Or maybe some credit for this downtime?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Sales and service.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: James here from Telecom Haiku. How can I help?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi James. So I'm looking to switch providers and I've heard your broadband service is really reliable. I'd like to learn more.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Absolutely, we have excellent broadband. Are you looking for high speed for gaming or streaming?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Yeah basically both. I like to game online and also watch movies.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Our 500 Mbps plan would be perfect for that. Want to sign up?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Customer retention services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Sarah from retention here. I understand you're thinking about leaving us?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Yeah, honestly I've had some issues with service quality lately. The speeds aren't what they used to be and I've had a couple outages.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. Those are valid concerns. What if we upgraded your service at no additional cost?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Oh really? That would be cool actually. What kind of upgrade are we talking about?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: We can move you to our premium tier with better infrastructure. No extra charge for six months, then it would be a small fee.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Support line.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Chris from support. What's wrong?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Chris. I forgot my password and I can't get into my online account. I tried the reset but the email isn't arriving.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: No problem. Let me send a password reset link from here. Check your spam folder just in case.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Oh yeah, it was in spam! I found it. Let me click on it now.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Great, you're all set now.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Telecom Haiku main line.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Lisa here. How can I help you?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Lisa. I'm looking at your coverage map and I'm trying to figure out if you serve my area. I'm in the northern part of the county.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Let me check that for you. What's your zip code?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: It's 45802. I'm pretty far out though, so I wasn't sure.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Billing services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Robert from billing. What can I help with?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Robert. So I got a bill and it includes a charge for last month but I thought that was already paid. I'm confused.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Let me look at your payment history here. I see what happened. There was a processing delay.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I'm going to adjust your account so you're not double charged. You should only owe this month's amount.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Okay, thanks for clearing that up. I was worried I'd been forgotten about.
